subject.title: [Bug]: /hooks/agent silently drops accountId — hook dispatch bypasses cron normalization pipeline

question: Should maintainers wait for linked PR #43951 to be refreshed with proof, or replace it with a current-main maintainer fix for `/hooks/agent` accountId preservation?
rationale: The bug is still present, but an open linked PR already claims the fix and needs maintainer handling rather than an automatic duplicate issue-lane repair.

options.title: Replace on current main
options.body: Close or supersede the stale/conflicting candidate with a small current-main fix plus docs, tests, and redacted multi-account hook proof.

options.title: Wait for PR #43951
options.body: Keep this issue linked to the contributor PR and require the author to refresh the branch and add real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Hold for broader hook API design
options.body: Pause the narrow fix only if maintainers want to redesign `/hooks/agent` delivery/account routing as a larger API decision.

recommendation.title: Replace on current main
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the stale/conflicting candidate with a small current-main fix plus docs, tests, and redacted multi-account hook proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor most recently maintained the gateway hook lines and adjacent routing surface on current main.
